parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file passes. PlaceOrderUseCase.execute only coordinates the steps of a use case, which is the job of the application layer. It turns the incoming command into domain objects with OrderLine.of and Order.place, using the injected IdGenerator and Clock. It then loads the needed products through EntityLookupService and hands stock reservation to the domain service StockAllocationService. Finally it saves through the OrderRepository and ProductRepository interfaces and returns a DTO from toOrderDto. The business rules themselves (building the order, reserving stock) are left to domain objects. Storage happens only through repository interfaces, with no database, framework or HTTP code. Creating StockAllocationService directly inside the class is a wiring choice, not a responsibility that belongs to another layer.
